objective: Build fix/worktree-ownership: reserve --worktree keys write-area overlap per worktree.
scope: Worktree worktree b, branch release/0.2.0/fix/worktree-ownership, based on PR #21 (0638af5).
constraints: Nothing about the worktree reaches committed records: no new record field, no absolute path; the key lives in local untracked state next to agent ids.
acceptance_criteria: assignment reserve --worktree <dir> makes <dir> the writable root (ownership paths resolve against it, OutsideWritableRoots checked against it) and records an opaque key for that worktree in local state.
Two writers with overlapping ownership paths conflict only when their worktree keys match; a reservation without --worktree keys to the project root, so existing behavior is unchanged.
The key is released with the reservation (finish, cancel, rollback, reconcile resolve --fail) and survives a CLI restart.
<dir> must be an existing directory; refuse otherwise with a tagged error.
assignments skill and README document --worktree compactly (wc -c before/after).
Tests cover overlap in the same worktree, no conflict across worktrees, default behavior, release, and the record files staying free of the key; bundle rebuilt; fmt, lint, typecheck, full test pass.
result: B built: reserve --worktree <dir> with sha256 realpath key in local/worktrees.json, overlap only within the same worktree, keyless rows hold against all, InvalidWorktree for missing or file paths, skill and README updated. 1226 pass, 1 fail: architecture allowlist rejects the new realpath import from node:fs/promises (outside ownership).

acceptance.rationale: Independent review zksq: no blockers, e2e across worktrees, records clean, older CLI compatible; empty-flag repair re-reviewed.
